scripts.e2e:metro: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_E2E=1 bunx expo start --port 8082
scripts.e2e: cd apps/mobile && MAESTRO_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1 maestro -p ios test .maestro
scripts.test: bun run functions:check && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.functions:check: out="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/meu-racha-domain-push.js" && bun build packages/domain/src/notification/push.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile "$out" > /dev/null && cmp -s "$out" supabase/functions/_shared/domain-push.js || { echo 'supabase/functions/_shared/domain-push.js desatualizado: rode bun functions:build'; exit 1; }
scripts.db:test: for f in supabase/tests/*.sql; do echo "$f"; docker exec -i -e PGOPTIONS="-c client_min_messages=warning" supabase_db_meu-racha-app psql -q -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done
scripts.db:types: bunx supabase gen types typescript --local > apps/mobile/src/lib/database.types.ts
